cheapEat.name: Tagine at a budget café
cheapEat.note: Chez Yassine lists tagines at 30 dirham; stall harira costs 10-15 dirham a bowl

RAK.saveTip: Eat at the cheaper Djemaa el-Fna stalls without greeters; menus show prices and harira starts at 10 dirham.

cheapEat.name: Set menu in New Talbourjt
cheapEat.note: Cheapest zone, menus from 35 dirham (undated Wikivoyage); sfinj costs 1-2 dirham

AGA.saveTip: Eat in New Talbourjt, the cheapest restaurant zone, not on the beachfront, which is the most expensive tourist zone.

cheapEat.name: Lablabi chickpea soup
cheapEat.note: 8-10 dinars a bowl at popular stalls, per a January 2026 expat guide

TUN.saveTip: Eat brik and fricassé from snack stands (1-5 dinars) rather than tourist restaurants, where couscous costs 15-25 dinars.

cheapEat.name: Chicken shawarma wrap
cheapEat.note: AED 8-15 at old Dubai cafeterias; karak chai costs AED 1-3 (2026 guide)

DXB.saveTip: Alcohol is only sold in licensed hotel bars and pubs, about 30-35 dirham a pint, so use happy hours (25-35 dirham).

cheapEat.name: Five khinkali dumplings
cheapEat.note: Klike's Khinkali: 1-2 lari per dumpling (Oct 2022); price assumes 5 at 1.5 lari

TBS.saveTip: Follow students to the cheaper bars where tourists are welcome, and avoid the overpriced drinks in the Old Town.

cheapEat.name: Beef kebab sandwich at Master Class
cheapEat.note: 1500 dram per Wikivoyage (Oct 2026); lahmajun stands sell a cheap snack

EVN.saveTip: Eat lahmajun, the cheap Armenian pizza, at local joints like Tun Lahmajo instead of sit-down restaurants.

cheapEat.name: Pad thai from a street stall
cheapEat.note: Carts and street restaurants charge about 50 baht; Boat Noodle Alley bowls are 50 baht too

BKK.saveTip: Eat at street stalls and noodle shops (bowls about 50-100 baht) and order Leo, which is 10-20% cheaper than Singha.

cheapEat.name: Hawker stall noodle bowl
cheapEat.note: Peter's Pork Noodle RM8.50-9.50; Soong Kee beef noodles RM11-13 (2025); roti canai RM1

KUL.saveTip: Eat at hawker stalls and mamak restaurants (noodles RM8-10, roti canai about RM1) and skip beer: a can costs RM7.50+.

cheapEat.name: Hawker centre chicken rice
cheapEat.note: S$5 at Wee Nam Kee, S$6 at Tian Tian; most hawker dishes cost S$4-6

SIN.saveTip: Eat at hawker centres, where most dishes cost S$4-6, and drink beer there (about S$7) instead of in bars (S$10-15).

cheapEat.name: Gyudon beef bowl at a chain
cheapEat.note: From about 450 yen at Yoshinoya, Matsuya or Sukiya; water or tea is usually free

TYO.saveTip: Eat gyudon and noodle-bar meals from about 450 yen (water or tea usually free); supermarkets discount food after 20:00.

cheapEat.name: Mayak gimbap at Gwangjang Market
cheapEat.note: Market stalls charge 3,000 won; bindaetteok costs 4,000 won

SEL.saveTip: Buy soju and beer at convenience stores, not bars, and eat in the food courts in department-store basements.

cheapEat.name: Banh mi from a street stall
cheapEat.note: 25,000-40,000 dong in 2026 (Vietnam Tourism); pho costs 40,000-70,000 dong

SGN.saveTip: Eat where locals do (plastic stools, printed wall menu, no English signs); banh mi costs 25,000-40,000 dong.

cheapEat.name: Weekday lounas lunch buffet
cheapEat.note: University canteen 8 euro for guests (2023); Finnish set lunches 8-15 euro with a drink

RVN.saveTip: Eat the weekday lounas buffet (8-15 euro, drink included) and buy beer in shops (about 2 euro, versus 5-6 in bars).

cheapEat.name: Weekday Mittagsmenü set lunch
cheapEat.note: Wikivoyage: lunch menus about 7-10 euro; Bosna sausage stands are the cheap street snack

SZG.saveTip: At Augustiner Bräustübl you may bring your own food (not drinks), and a half-litre beer costs 3.60 euro.

cheapEat.name: Tarte flambée at Flam's
cheapEat.note: Traditionnelle is 8.20 euro on the Flam's Frères carte; gratinée 10.20 euro

SXB.saveTip: Ask for a free carafe d'eau and share a choucroute garnie, a heaping plate big enough for two, instead of two mains.

cheapEat.name: Canelé from a pâtissier
cheapEat.note: PM Pâtissier Bordelais lists 1.90 euro; Baillardran is pricier

BOD.saveTip: Ask for a free carafe d'eau, and try the galette-and-cider menu at Creperie Saint-Michel for under 14 euro.

cheapEat.name: Pintxo at a bar counter
cheapEat.note: Pintxos cost 1-3 euro each (Wikipedia); Wikivoyage says 2-3 euro in San Sebastián

BIO.saveTip: Order a zurito or caña of tap beer, normally cheaper than bottles, with counter pintxos at 1-3 euro each.

cheapEat.name: Cheap taverna meal in centre
cheapEat.note: City-centre tavernas serve full meals for under 20 euro for two people

HER.saveTip: Eat at cheap city-centre tavernas, or keep a strict budget by buying fruit, vegetables and cheese at supermarkets.

cheapEat.name: Lahmacun Turkish thin pizza
cheapEat.note: Lahmacun about 2-3 euro, pide 4-8 euro per a 2026 Antalya transfer-firm guide

AYT.saveTip: Eat around Muratpaşa Mosque or at esnaf lokantası workers' eateries, and have simit from street carts for breakfast.

cheapEat.name: Papas arrugadas with mojo
cheapEat.note: Salted wrinkly potatoes with mojo sauce, a Canarian tapa; no price found

FUE.saveTip: Order the menú del día at lunch, a fixed-price meal where water or wine is commonly included.

cheapEat.name: Gromperekichelcher potato fritters
cheapEat.note: Christmas-market snack; Winterlights runs 20 Nov 2026 to 3 Jan 2027; no price found

LUX.saveTip: A modest dinner and drink tops 20 euro, so eat cheap near Place d'Armes or at dish-of-the-day cafes.
